title: risk-calibrated-stego: Conformal risk control for per-image payload allocation in image steganography under steganalyzer mismatch
description: Notebook, results and figures for calibrating per-image payload allocation in spatial-domain image steganography (HILL, BOSSbase 1.01) by conformal risk control, with a leave-one-detector-out test of transfer to independent steganalyzers.
